name: scaffold-template-library
body: Scaffold template library: create a new, deck-ready library at a target path — write `library.yaml` (name derived from the directory base name and validated against the `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*` identifier convention, `format: 1`), the empty layout entries `slides/`, `sections/` and `media/`, and a minimal `themes/default/theme.css` (system fonts and neutral colours only) so that a deck's defaulted `theme` resolves (theme-selection); refuse to clobber an existing library (a present `library.yaml` or any layout entry) with no `--force`; local filesystem only (no network, no git).
